# [Company] Quality Manual - ISO 9001:2008

Issue 3

## Purpose
This manual describes the quality system. The quality manual is required by the standard.

## Management representative
The management representative ensures the six mandatory procedures are maintained.

## Exclusions
Clause 7.3 and 8.5.6 are not applicable.
Clause 8.3 is excluded.

## Requirements
The organization shall determine external issues. The organization shall plan actions.
The organization shall maintain documented information. Preventive action is handled in QP-08.
